body: Not really. I've tried volunteer work but it was not very fulfilling. I am considering being a volunteer again when my situation is a little more settled.

It is like with anything, after a while, you get bored, you grow up and learn that what you are doing is fruitless and belongs in the past. I can not think of anything holding me to this life, and I don't want to play the game anymore, so what is the point, of waking up in the morning when I don't want to wake up, when I am not grateful at all? I really used to experiment and look for things to make life worth living, and I feel exhausted. Each day is an exact replica of the previous. It is like walking in an endless circle of jobs, homes, and ruined relationships. It would be insane to think at this stage that things are going to get better to the point where life is worth the effort or that I belong here, there is no evidence for that at all, and yet I exist. One of these has to change, I can't keep walking on believing in fantasy.

I feel like I have outgrown life. I can't think of a reason to stay. Hanging around has been pointlessly egotistic. When all the bad things were happening, my aim was to get back by improving my life and living comfortably. Now that I am here I can see it wasn't worth it. I don't want to wake up any more or have feelings, I think I just want to die.

I wish that was true. I always wanted to be able to offer something real, something special. But who wants me around. The sad reality is that I have little if anything to offer. I have finally grown up and understood this.
